fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-01-26 at approximately 18:30, it was reported that a caller claiming to be a bank executive asked the complainant to install a support application, after which Rs. 12,000 was withdrawn. Naveen Natarajan approached Vellore Town PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000057. A witness, Elango Krishnan, reachable on 9000000081, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant alleged that Logesh Karuppasamy may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000198. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100020 as the destination of the transfer. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly posed as a bank executive and asked for remote access.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, college road, suspect, screenshot, evening, receiving account, mobile number
